[ASSISTANT_SAID] Basic strategies for meditation include:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Find a quiet and comfortable place to practice.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Set a time limit, starting with five or ten minutes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Focus on your breath and count each inhale and exhale.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Acknowledge when your mind wanders and bring focus back to your breath.
